### ✨ Pascal's Wager Mod Menu (v1.11.9)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **God Mode (Invincible)** — Zero HP damage taken & cannot die
- **Auto-Max All Bars** — Locks HP, MP, Stamina, Rage & Sanity at 100%
- **Defense Multiplier** — Divides incoming HP damage by this factor
- **1-Hit Kill Enemies** — All attacks deal 9,999,999 damage to enemies
- **Damage Multiplier** — Multiplies all HP & Toughness damage dealt to enemies
- **Attack Stat Multiplier** — Multiplies hero base Attack stat (GetAttackBase)
- **100% Critical Hit** — Every hit lands as a critical strike
- **Infinite Stamina & No Cooldown** — Dodges, sprints, attacks & skills cost 0 stamina with 0 recovery delay
- **Infinite Rage / Power / MP** — Special skills cost 0 Rage/Power/MP and bars never decay
- **Infinite Sanity (Never Insane)** — Prevents Sanity drain against bosses & eerie areas
- **Instant Full Heal & Refill Bars** — Restores HP, MP, Stamina, Rage, Sanity & Potions to max
- **Infinite Items, Gold & Potions** — Bag items, Bone/Sendril currencies, stones & potions never decrease
- **Unlock All Talents & Free Upgrades** — Unlocks all talent nodes & bypasses stone requirements
- **Max All Owned Bag Items** — Sets every item & currency currently in your bag to max stack
- **Add +9999 Currencies & Materials** — Adds +9999 Bone, Sendril, Stones, Potions & Upgrade Materials
- **+999 Talent & Attribute Points** — Grants 999 Talent/Attribute points & 99 HP/MP Potions
- **Instant Stagger / Break Toughness** — Breaks enemy & boss toughness/weakness gauge in 1 hit
- **Freeze Enemy AI (Dummy Mode)** — Disables enemy AI brains so enemies stand still
- **Freeze Enemy HP** — Enemies take 0 HP damage (combo practice mode)
- **Fly / NoClip Mode** — Enables built-in engine flight mode (DebugFly)
- **Game Speed Multiplier** — Scales Unity engine Time.timeScale (1.0x = normal speed)
- **Check LuaJIT Hook Status** — Displays active lua_State pointer & frame counter

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
